title: Minimalist header — three ways to make it visible

steps.headline: Which approach makes the header easier to see without looking harsh?
steps.notice: The full-width veil stays off. The selected session remains more transparent. These are temporary visual options in the real renderer; none has been made the default.

variants.label: Soft glass cushions
variants.summary: A faint neutral tint lives inside each button and the session switcher, leaving the wallpaper visible between them. The dots get a stronger same-color glow.
variants.risk: Individual buttons read more like small surfaces than pure glass.

variants.label: Colored glyph glow
variants.summary: Buttons stay clear; icon colors borrow some of the theme accent and glow more. Status dots glow in their own colors.
variants.risk: The brighter dots and icons can feel too luminous on dark themes.

variants.label: Sculpted edges
variants.summary: No button tint: subtle inner highlights and deeper local shadows reveal each shape. Dot glows become a little stronger without a white ring.
variants.risk: Visible edges may feel too much like outlined buttons.
